name: Empire Precision Plastics
old_description: Precision Injection & Scientific Molding with Assembly Services
about:
Empire Precision Plastics operates from Rochester, New York, where it was founded in 1992. The company is led by Chief Executive Officer Joe Buonocore, who began his career as a machine operator and later held profit-and-loss responsibility for a global injection molding business.

The nearly 70,000-square-foot facility houses 50 late-model electric and hydraulic injection molding machines, nearly 80 percent of which are automated. An in-house tool shop supports full-service mold design and build. Core processes include scientific injection molding, white-room molding and assembly, polymer optics molding, MuCell microcellular foaming, thermoplastic elastomer insert and over-molding, multi-component (two-shot) molding, and high-heat engineering material processing. Downstream assembly capabilities encompass ultrasonic welding, heat staking, machining, pad printing, and electro-optical assembly, with work cells integrated into the molding cycle.

The company serves medical and healthcare, military and defense, aerospace, industrial, optics, polymer optics, consumer electronics, and firearms sectors. Customers range from OEMs requiring production-intent prototypes to those transferring existing production tools for high-volume manufacturing.

Empire Precision emphasizes a scientific molding approach combined with in-house tooling, engineering-based DFM and Moldflow analysis, and a culture of zero defects and continuous improvement. The firm invests in employee development, internal processes, and business systems to deliver solutions that address customers' most challenging injection molding problems.
